title: Troubleshooting a showroom display
passage:
[Document 1] Work order | Showroom west wall
The product display is difficult to read from the demonstration counter around 4 P.M. The screen looks normal when staff stand beside it. Please test the change from the counter, where customers will be watching the demonstration.

[Document 2] Installer’s test card
With a blank white image on the screen, briefly cover each suspected light source in turn. A bright streak that vanishes during a cover test is a reflection of that source. Reduce that source or change the angle before changing the screen settings. If a streak stays visible through all cover tests and can be seen from beside the screen as well, check for a fault in the display.

[Document 3] Follow-up from the floor supervisor
I stood at the demonstration counter at 4 P.M. and covered the upper window with the roller shade. The bright streak went away, but the shade also made the display samples too dark. It came back when I opened the shade. I repeated the test with the window uncovered and the track lights switched off one at a time; the streak stayed. Tomorrow's demonstration will use the same counter and the samples must remain visible. I have not moved the display because I wanted the installer to see this report first.
passageZh:
【文件一】工單｜展示間西牆
下午四點左右，從示範櫃檯看不清產品展示螢幕上的內容。員工站在螢幕旁時，看起來正常。請從顧客將觀看示範的櫃檯測試調整效果。

【文件二】安裝人員測試卡
螢幕顯示空白白色畫面時，逐一短暫遮蔽各個可疑光源。如果某次遮蔽時亮紋消失，亮紋就是該光源的反射。調整螢幕設定前，應先減弱該光源或改變角度。如果所有遮蔽測試中亮紋都不消失，而且從螢幕旁也看得到，再檢查螢幕有沒有故障。

【文件三】現場主管的追蹤說明
我下午四點站在示範櫃檯，放下捲簾遮住上方窗戶。亮紋消失了，但捲簾也讓展示樣品變得太暗。捲簾打開後，亮紋又出現。我保持窗戶不遮蔽，再逐一關掉軌道燈重測；亮紋仍在。明天的示範會使用同一個櫃檯，且一定要看得清楚樣品。我還沒移動螢幕，想先讓安裝人員看過這份紀錄。
